1. Trigger — A trigger flickers. First Frame — soften shoulders.
2. Pause Story — Do not explain it yet.
3. Capture Thought — Pin the first mental sentence, picture, or prediction exactly as it arrived. First Frame — allow opposite.
4. Quote — Put quotation marks around it.
5. Close Capture — The catch ends there; no life story, no courtroom, no spiral. First Frame — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Close Capture.

rituals.title: THE TWO-TRAY TEST
rituals.name: THE TWO-TRAY TEST
rituals.hook: Test: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.recognition_cue: Test: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.goal: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.mission: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.challenge: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.immediate_need: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Imagine Trays → Sort Facts → Balance Verdict
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Imagine Trays → Sort Facts → Balance Verdict
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Imagine Trays → Sort Facts → Balance Verdict
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays. Two Tray — hear sound.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence. Two Tray — notice detail.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same. Two Tray — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Balance Verdict.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Balance Verdict clicked.

MY RESULT
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.my_result: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.formula_flow: Imagine Trays → Name Sides → Sort Facts → Switch Sides → Balance Verdict

rituals.name: WORST CASE, WITH EXITS
rituals.hook: Try: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.recognition_cue: Try: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Try: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line. Worst Case — feel support.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely. Worst Case — add counterfact.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now. Worst Case — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act Now.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Act Now held.

MY RESULT
My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.
rituals.my_result: My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Fear → Build Exits → Add Likely → Climb Route → Act Now

rituals.name: THE GREY DIAL
rituals.hook: Flip: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.recognition_cue: Flip: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.goal: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.mission: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.challenge: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Extremes → Place Today → Choose Response
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Extremes → Place Today → Choose Response
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Flip: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Extremes → Place Today → Choose Response
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Extremes — Name the two extremes your mind is using. Grey Dial — move slowly.
2. Build Scale — Build a 0–10 scale between them and say three real anchor points: 2, 5, and 8.
3. Place Today — Place today’s event where the evidence fits—not where the emotion shouts. Grey Dial — find evidence.
4. Choose Response — Choose a response matched to that exact setting. Grey Dial — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Response.

GOAL
Choose before distress turns choice into fog.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Prepare Five → Select Option → Finish Interval
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Prepare Five — Prepare five ten-minute diversions across different channels: hands, movement, sound, practical task, safe contact. Crisis Menu — widen gaze.
2. Select Option — During a spike, select the first available option without browsing for the perfect one. Crisis Menu — allow opposite.
3. Finish Interval — Finish the interval, reassess safety, then either return or choose support. Crisis Menu — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Interval.

THE CRISIS MENU

TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Pause: Choose before distress turns choice into fog.

GOAL
Choose before distress turns choice into fog.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Prepare Five → Select Option → Finish Interval

1. Prepare Five — Prepare five ten-minute diversions across different channels: hands, movement, sound, practical task, safe contact. Crisis Menu — widen gaze.
2. Select Option — During a spike, select the first available option without browsing for the perfect one. Crisis Menu — allow opposite.
3. Finish Interval — Finish the interval, reassess safety, then either return or choose support. Crisis Menu — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Interval.

WIN SIGNAL
Finish Interval closed.

MY RESULT
I can choose before distress turns choice into fog.

Prepare Five → Select Option → Finish Interval

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Check Support → Speak Gently → Match Posture
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Check Support — Verify that the facts do not support the action impulse. Reverse Urge — move slowly.
2. Speak Gently — Then perform its full safe opposite: approach instead of avoid, speak gently instead of attack, straighten instead of collapse, engage instead of hide. Reverse Urge — name feeling.
3. Match Posture — Match posture, words, and behaviour until the new signal is coherent. Reverse Urge — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Match Posture.

Match Posture clicked.

MY RESULT
When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Identify Chapter → Pause Meaning → Continue Genuine
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Chapter — Spot the current chapter only: sensation, meaning, action urge, or settling. Let Emotion — move slowly.
2. Permit — Permit the next natural chapter while withholding later ones.
3. Pause Meaning — If sensation is active, do not interpret; if meaning is clear, do not act yet. Let Emotion — name feeling.
4. Continue Genuine — Continue until a genuine settling marker—breath change, warmth, tears ending, posture release—appears. Let Emotion — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Continue Genuine.

4. Preserve Forecast — Do not let hindsight rewrite the original forecast. Capture Model — next action.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Rate Sure — Rate how sure you feel from 0–100. Confidence Evidence — loosen hands.

4. Follow Evidence — Let the evidence meter choose the action; treat the confidence meter as a feeling to notice, not a vote. Confidence Evidence — next action.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Look: Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Seat Feelings → Clear Board → Choose Survivor
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Seat Feelings — Label up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first. Find Move — hear sound.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty. Find Move — plain wording.

rituals.trigger_play_time:

PLAY TIME

HOOK
Notice: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Stack → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block. Play Emotion — soften shoulders.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Observe what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference. Play Emotion — name feeling.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing. Play Emotion — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Rebuild Stack.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Peek: A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Identify Whose → Ask Whether → Keep Repair
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Whose — Spot whose rule the shame is enforcing and the setting where it was learned. Return Shame — loosen hands.
2. Ask Whether — Check whether you still endorse that standard. Return Shame — split duty.
3. Keep Repair — Keep any ethical repair that is truly yours; return contempt, prejudice, or impossible expectation to its source. Return Shame — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Repair.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Keep Repair registered.

MY RESULT
A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.

GAME MOVE

items.play_the_loop:
1. Trigger — A trigger flickers. First Frame — soften shoulders.
2. Pause Story — Do not explain it yet.
3. Capture Thought — Pin the first mental sentence, picture, or prediction exactly as it arrived. First Frame — allow opposite.
4. Quote — Put quotation marks around it.
5. Close Capture — The catch ends there; no life story, no courtroom, no spiral. First Frame — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Close Capture.

1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays. Two Tray — hear sound.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line. Worst Case — feel support.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely. Worst Case — add counterfact.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now. Worst Case — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act Now.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Trusted — Imagine a trusted person bringing you the same facts. Borrow Their — loosen hands.
2. Offer Allowances — Hold the questions you would ask them, the allowances you would make, and the evidence you would require before judging them.
3. Remove Name — Now remove their name. Borrow Their — allow opposite.
4. Apply Page — Apply that page to yourself without adding a harsher clause. Borrow Their — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Apply Page.

3. Continue Stable — Continue only until one stable rule repeats. Rule Under — pick action.
4. Box Rule — Box Rule Rule that rule.
5. Today — Today’s task is to inspect it, not obey it. Rule Under — next action.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Separate Cards — Separate four cards: prompting event, meaning, verified evidence, actual present threat. Does Feeling — breathe naturally.
2. Compare Emotion — Compare the emotion’s intensity and duration with the fourth card.
3. Use Feeling — If they fit, use the feeling’s message. Does Feeling — name feeling.
4. Update Meaning — If they exceed it, regulate first and update the meaning. Does Feeling — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Update Meaning.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Check Support — Verify that the facts do not support the action impulse. Reverse Urge — move slowly.
2. Speak Gently — Then perform its full safe opposite: approach instead of avoid, speak gently instead of attack, straighten instead of collapse, engage instead of hide. Reverse Urge — name feeling.
3. Match Posture — Match posture, words, and behaviour until the new signal is coherent. Reverse Urge — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Match Posture.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Emotion → Safe → Choose Safe
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Emotion — Label the emotion in one word. Urge Emotion — widen gaze.
2. Hide Name — Name every behaviour it is urging—text, withdraw, shout, spend, hide, check.
3. Safe — Notice each SAFE, COSTLY, or UNCLEAR. Urge Emotion — name feeling.
4. Choose Safe — Select a low-risk move that respects the emotion without automatically enacting its favourite instruction. Urge Emotion — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Safe.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Switch: A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Pick Detail → Rate Confidence → Keep Core
items.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event. Stamp Where — press feet.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity. Stamp Where — allow opposite.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty. Stamp Where — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Core.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Keep Core locked.

GOAL
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Take Event → Identify Facts → Try Construction
items.play_the_loop:
1. Take Event — Take one rigid reading of an event. Waking Dream — soften shoulders.
2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed. Waking Dream — estimate odds.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes. Waking Dream — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Try Construction.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Keep Both Versions — The moment an outcome differs from expectation, Keep both versions verbatim. Capture Model — breathe naturally.
2. State Size — State the size and direction of the error.
3. Name Miss — Finish with: ‘The old model must now explain…’ and name the discrepancy. Capture Model — estimate odds.
4. Preserve Forecast — Do not let hindsight rewrite the original forecast. Capture Model — next action.

items.play_the_loop:

4. Compare Action — Compare which action remains robust across versions. Same Facts — next action.

items.trigger_play_time:

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Seat Feelings → Clear Board → Choose Survivor
items.play_the_loop:
1. Seat Feelings — Label up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first. Find Move — hear sound.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty. Find Move — plain wording.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it. Find Move — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Survivor.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Choose Survivor locked.

MY RESULT
I just lowered the heat without giving up my point.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block. Play Emotion — soften shoulders.

4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing. Play Emotion — next action.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Identify Whose → Ask Whether → Keep Repair
items.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Whose — Spot whose rule the shame is enforcing and the setting where it was learned. Return Shame — loosen hands.
2. Ask Whether — Check whether you still endorse that standard. Return Shame — split duty.
3. Keep Repair — Keep any ethical repair that is truly yours; return contempt, prejudice, or impossible expectation to its source. Return Shame — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Repair.

PAUSE

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
